item.title: Republican, Democrat Party Platforms Now Just Lists Of People They Would Arrest
item.description: U.S. — The political system in the United States took a sharp turn away from addressing practical issues facing the nation, as both the Republican and Democratic party platforms were replaced with lists of people they would arrest.

item.title: Tim Walz Emerges From Den To Declare 6 More Weeks Of Rioting And Fraud
item.description: ST. PAUL, MN — Governor Tim Walz has emerged from the den of the Governor's Mansion to declare that there will be six more weeks of rioting and fraud.

item.title: Sandwich Ruined After Not Being Cut In Triangles
item.description: U.S. — What had been expected to be a delightful lunch was thrown into chaos and threatened to destroy an entire day, as a local man's sandwich was completely ruined after not being cut into triangles.

item.title: Tearful Trump Ends Deportations After Seeing Celebrities Wearing ‘ICE OUT’ Pins
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — A tearful President Trump has reportedly issued a halt on all deportations and ordered the immediate withdraw of ICE from Minnesota after witnessing celebrities wear pins that said "ICE OUT" during the Grammys.

item.title: Roomful Of Pedophiles Protest ICE Deporting Pedophiles
item.description: LOS ANGELES, CA — A room full of pedophiles in attendance at Sunday night's Grammys ceremony defiantly protested Trump's deportation of pedophiles.

item.title: Peter Dinklage Receives Little Praise After Taking Short Time To Recite Small Poem
item.description: NEW YORK, NY — Actor Peter Dinklage was reportedly a wee bit annoyed and expressed slight disappointment that he received little praise from the general public after taking a short time to recite a small poem at an anti-ICE protest over the weekend.
